quarrelsome_hexaco: This means nursing a grudge against anyone who has done one wrong, being critical of other people's shortcomings, refusing to budge in an argument, and quick to anger when wronged.
conventional_hexaco: This means walking past most art unmoved, incurious about anything outside one's own patch, leaving painting, writing and invention to others, and feeling little pull toward radical or unconventional ideas.
sly_hexaco: This means flattering people to get what one wants, ready to break a rule when it pays, out for whatever one can gain, and acting as if one matters more than others.
tough_hexaco: This means pressing on where one could get hurt, staying unworried under pressure, seldom sharing one's troubles or leaning on anyone, and holding people at arm's length.
emotional_hexaco: This means flinching from physical danger, worrying when life gets stressful, needing a shoulder to lean on, and forming tender attachments to people, feeling their pain as one's own.
honest_humble_hexaco: This means dealing straight with people rather than working them for gain, keeping to the rules even when cheating would pay, caring little for riches and luxury, and claiming no special standing.
extraverted_hexaco: This means liking who one is, stepping up to lead or address a crowd without a flutter, enjoying a party and a good talk, and running on enthusiasm and energy.
conscientious_hexaco: This means keeping one's room and one's appointments in order, grinding steadily toward a goal, polishing work until it is exactly right, and weighing a decision carefully before making it.
careless_hexaco: This means letting the room get messy and appointments slide, steering clear of hard tasks and ambitious goals, handing in work with mistakes in it, and deciding on impulse.
